{{Quote|So I am a frelling punk, huh? Just gutter chaff looking to a dumpster to die in? I don't think so! Can a punk do this?!?|Miko|<ref name="No Place Like Home">{{LivingForce|No Place Like Home}}</ref>}}
'''Miko''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], who lived in [[Oluna Biqua]] on [[Genarius]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
While Miko was a teenager, he was infected with the gas [[Trinex-M]], along with the rest of the population of Oluna Biqua. It drove him insane and gave him the power to use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. He attacked the [[Heroes of Cularin]] with [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]].
